WITH date_filter AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1189 + 11
), store_sales_filtered AS (
    SELECT ss_customer_sk, ss_sold_date_sk
    FROM store_sales
    INNER JOIN date_filter ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_filter.d_date_sk
), catalog_sales_filtered AS (
    SELECT cs_bill_customer_sk, cs_sold_date_sk
    FROM catalog_sales
    INNER JOIN date_filter ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = date_filter.d_date_sk
), web_sales_filtered AS (
    SELECT ws_bill_customer_sk, ws_sold_date_sk
    FROM web_sales
    INNER JOIN date_filter ON web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = date_filter.d_date_sk
)
SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM (
    SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date
    FROM store_sales_filtered JOIN customer ON store_sales_filtered.ss_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk AND store_sales_filtered.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    INTERSECT ALL
    SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date
    FROM catalog_sales_filtered JOIN customer ON catalog_sales_filtered.cs_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk AND catalog_sales_filtered.cs_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    INTERSECT ALL
    SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date
    FROM web_sales_filtered JOIN customer ON web_sales_filtered.ws_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk AND web_sales_filtered.ws_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
) AS result
LIMIT 100
